title: SAP SuccessFactors 2H 2026 Release: Delivering the Future of Human Capital Management
author: Rebecca Carr
content_snippet: We're bringing together agentic AI, trusted workforce data, and HR applications to help deliver the outcomes that matter most to organizations.
content_full:
As workforce challenges continue to outpace traditional HR processes, the organizations that lead won’t be the ones with the most AI. They’ll be the ones that understand their people, their skills, and how work really gets done—and know where AI can move them beyond incremental improvement into lasting transformation.

Turn HR into a strategic growth engine with AI 
Discover Autonomous HCM

With the SAP SuccessFactors 2H 2026 release and throughout the remainder of the year, we’re taking the next step toward Autonomous HCM, bringing together agentic AI, trusted workforce data, and HR applications to help deliver the outcomes that matter most to organizations. At its core are three pillars: automate the HR function to release capacity from administrative work, redesign how tasks, workflows, roles, and teams are structured across people and AI, and reinvent how organizations recruit, develop, move, and reward their people.

This vision comes to life through Joule Assistants working together across SAP applications to help carry out end-to-end HR processes and help people make better decisions, faster, all within a single workspace: Joule Work. This is what it looks like when AI works across an organization’s data, applications, and processes: not more AI for the sake of AI, but AI that delivers impact you can measure.

Building on the SAP investments organizations have already made, the innovations we’re delivering throughout the second half of 2026 help automate, redesign, and reinvent work to realize the full promise of Autonomous HCM.

These innovations span the full employee lifecycle:

Plan & hire

Finding, hiring, and onboarding the right talent gets easier and faster, with every step aligned to business needs.

  • As AI drives up application volumes, recruiters risk spending more time clearing a queue than assessing if a hire works for the business. Winston Screen can address this with repeatable, configurable screening that helps narrow large applicant pools to a focused shortlist. Winston Match builds on that, with results now fully reportable in Report Builder, giving recruiters visibility into the reasoning behind AI-assisted decisions. Together, they help free up the time and attention to do what the business actually needs—apply their judgement to identify and engage the candidates most likely to succeed.
  • SmartRecruiters for SAP SuccessFactors helps put agentic capability directly inside the recruiter workflow so hiring never loses momentum, with Winston Companion monitoring pipelines and booking interviews through agentic scheduling, Winston Interview delivering a conversational AI-led screening experience, and the Interview Summary Agent automatically capturing and posting a structured summary to the candidate profile.
  • Helping new hires get up to speed and start contributing faster, the Onboarding Assistant equips HR teams to deliver personalized, timely onboarding at scale, with intelligent prioritization, simplified onboarding task creation, and automated custom form conversion.

Manage & pay

These innovations help organizations work more efficiently and stay compliant while giving employees fast, seamless support to reduce the routine inquiry burden on HR teams.

  • The Payroll Assistant helps build trust in payroll so employees can have confidence in every paycheck. Administrators can quickly identify anomalies, resolve issues, and stay ahead of compliance, while employees can get direct access to clear, confident answers about their pay without raising a support ticket.
  • The HR Operations Assistant can reduce manual effort, prevent bottlenecks, and keep HR processes moving, proactively resolving workforce and payroll data issues, automating employee and job changes, and streamlining position management. It can also detect approval bottlenecks, nudge approvers, and recommend next steps.
  • The HR System Assistant can give HR administrators a smarter way to manage day-to-day system operations—from audit readiness and compliance tracking to time and benefits configurations—reducing routine maintenance and helping HR teams drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Develop & grow

These innovations connect skill-building, learning, and career development into a more intentional experience designed for continuous growth.

  • The Learning Assistant helps move organizations to proactive workforce readiness, connecting compliance monitoring, upskilling, and development in one experience. It can guide the right learning actions at the right time for employees, managers, and admins, from flagging compliance deadlines to identifying skill gaps and recommending targeted learning.
  • People perform at their best when they know their employer is invested in their development. The Career and Talent Development Assistant helps employees close skill gaps, build personalized development plans, and set meaningful goals. For leaders, conversational talent discovery through Joule helps surface internal candidates, successors, and experts with a clear explanation of what shaped each result, helping organizations match the right talent to opportunities and grow people from within.

The next step toward Autonomous HCM

These are not standalone capabilities. Together, they are Autonomous HCM in action: AI working with trusted data and HR processes to remove friction, surface insight, and give people the space to focus on outcomes that matter. The organizations building that way today are the ones that will lead tomorrow.

Discover what’s new in the SAP SuccessFactors 2H 2026 release with the release brochure or overview video.

Rebecca Carr is president of HCM Products for SAP SuccessFactors and CEO for SmartRecruiters.
